import React from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Paper,
  Grid,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  Cell,
  ResponsiveContainer
} from 'recharts';

const Reports: React.FC = () => {
  // Dados de exemplo para os gráficos
  const salesData = [
    { name: 'Jan', vendas: 4000, pedidos: 240 },
    { name: 'Fev', vendas: 3000, pedidos: 139 },
    { name: 'Mar', vendas: 2000, pedidos: 980 },
    { name: 'Abr', vendas: 2780, pedidos: 390 },
    { name: 'Mai', vendas: 1890, pedidos: 480 },
    { name: 'Jun', vendas: 2390, pedidos: 380 },
  ];

  const productData = [
    { name: 'Pizza', value: 400, color: '#0088FE' },
    { name: 'Hambúrguer', value: 300, color: '#00C49F' },
    { name: 'Bebidas', value: 300, color: '#FFBB28' },
    { name: 'Sobremesas', value: 200, color: '#FF8042' },
  ];

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" component="h1" gutterBottom>
        Relatórios
      </Typography>

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Resumo de Vendas */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Vendas do Mês
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                R$ 15.240,00
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                +12% em relação ao mês anterior
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Pedidos do Mês
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                342
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                +8% em relação ao mês anterior
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Ticket Médio
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                R$ 44,56
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                +3% em relação ao mês anterior
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Mesas Ativas
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                8
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                de 12 mesas disponíveis
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Gráfico de Vendas */}
        <Grid item xs={12} lg={8}>
          <Paper sx={{ p: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              Vendas por Mês
            </Typography>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <BarChart data={salesData}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                <XAxis dataKey="name" />
                <YAxis />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend />
                <Bar dataKey="vendas" fill="#8884d8" name="Vendas (R$)" />
                <Bar dataKey="pedidos" fill="#82ca9d" name="Pedidos" />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </Paper>
        </Grid>

        {/* Gráfico de Produtos */}
        <Grid item xs={12} lg={4}>
          <Paper sx={{ p: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              Produtos Mais Vendidos
            </Typography>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={productData}
                  cx="50%"
                  cy="50%"
                  labelLine={false}
                  label={({ name, percent }: { name: string; percent: number }) => `${name} ${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
                  outerRadius={80}
                  fill="#8884d8"
                  dataKey="value"
                >
                  {productData.map((entry, index) => (
                    <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={entry.color} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </Paper>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Reports;
